title: Bishop in a Box
setup: Black's bishop has burrowed all the way to b1, where its only two neighbors are your pawns on a2 and c2.
hint: That bishop already has no move at all. Bring up a piece that hits it and guards a2 in the same breath.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nc3}} attacks the bishop and covers a2 at the same time, and c2 is defended by the bishop on d1, so there is no capture to escape with either. A piece with nowhere to go needs only one attacker to fall.
